headlineRule: normalization and transport are two different claims and are reported separately on purpose. The standing owner instruction is: do not simulate hosted IPv6 and call it proof.

normalization.negativeControlMeaning: assertion 25 deliberately claims two different IPv4 addresses share a bucket. It was reported as 'not ok', so the 24 passes are a measurement rather than a vacuous run.
coverage: public-unicast classification for IPv4 and IPv6, rejecting RFC1918, loopback, link-local and unique-local
NAT64 well-known prefix 64:ff9b:: unwrapping, and RFC6052 /96 extraction
a genuine IPv6 address has no embedded IPv4
NO DUAL-FAMILY BYPASS: an IPv4-mapped address buckets identically to the bare IPv4
NO NAT64 BYPASS: a NAT64-translated address buckets identically to the IPv4
/64 grouping — same prefix shares a bucket, different prefix does not
refusal of NULL, empty, malformed, multi-valued XFF-style, private IPv4 and link-local IPv6
normalization.executedAgainst: the real hosted Postgres 17 engine and the real staged catalog on cepayqmsoqxshsiyqnvz
normalization.residue: NONE — the suite ran inside one transaction that was rolled back

reason1_noAAAAOnTheIngestHostname.measured: dig AAAA cepayqmsoqxshsiyqnvz.supabase.co -> 0 records. Only A: 172.64.149.246, 104.18.38.10 (Cloudflare).
reason1_noAAAAOnTheIngestHostname.consequence: no client anywhere can open an IPv6 connection to this staging surface, because no AAAA is published for it. A property of the deployment, not of the test.

reason2_theTestMachineIsNotTheLimitation.measured: curl -6 https://one.one.one.one/ returned HTTP 200 from 2606:4700:4700::1001; this host holds 2 global-scope IPv6 addresses.
reason2_theTestMachineIsNotTheLimitation.measured2: curl -6 to the staging host connected to ::ffff:104.18.38.10 — an IPv4-mapped socket, i.e. it fell back to the A record. The connection was IPv4.
reason2_theTestMachineIsNotTheLimitation.consequence: the inability to originate hosted IPv6 is not an environment excuse: IPv6 egress was demonstrated to a different host in the same run.

reason3_noGuestIngestFunctionExists.measured: the branch deploys send-push-notification v6, notify-flag-status v8 and delete-account v4. No function source reads cf-connecting-ip.
reason3_noGuestIngestFunctionExists.consequence: even over IPv4 there is no hosted code path that reads a trusted client address and calls the limiter, so end-to-end hosted ingestion of ANY address family cannot be proven here.

whyTransportIsOpen.notSimulated: no synthetic IPv6 transport was constructed and no such claim is made

reproducesFirstRun: the first run recorded the same three reasons on the old branch. Independently re-measured here on the fresh branch rather than carried over.
